description: Watch together for two: sync YouTube, MP4 and local files between exactly two viewers. Astro + Cloudflare Workers/Durable Objects + R2.
name: eigakan-watch-together

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -k -n worker,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test --workspace @eigakan/sync-core
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspace @eigakan/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @eigakan/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace @eigakan/sync-core
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
